in_marathi.name: Dhanesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhanesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'dhan,' meaning wealth or prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Dhanesh is a name for the planet Jupiter, associated with wisdom, luck, and abundance. This name is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity to the one who bears it.
